*[[Killing of Brian Thompson]]
**[[United States federal judge]] [[Margaret Garnett]] dismisses the [[Murder in United States law|federal murder]] and [[Criminal possession of a weapon|weapon]] charges against [[Luigi Mangione]] in the killing of former [[UnitedHealthcare]] CEO Brian Thompson, ruling out the [[Capital punishment in the United States|death penalty]] against Mangione. The judge maintains the [[stalking]] charges, which carries a maximum sentence of [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life imprisonment]].
